text:
carmen: Quick ask — we need a small asset pack for the webinar next Tuesday (inbound funnel). Not a full redesign, just: cover tiles, 3 benchmark callout graphics, a social template, and a 1-slide deck cover. Brand must be clean & production-ready. Can design take these?

raj: yep — timeline?

carmen: Need final assets by Mon EOD (one business day for QA). Can you do dark + light variants. Also need an editable Figma with components.

emma: tagging @lee for benchmarks visuals. Lee, do you have the final numbers/art direction we should call out?

lee: putting numbers here: median latency 86ms (p95 220ms), cost per 1k tokens $0.38, inference throughput 220 req/s on dedicated pool. Want visuals that emphasize latency vs cost tradeoff — small sparkline + large number.

emma: design notes: use primary #0057D9, accent #00C2A6, white/text on dark for dark mode. Typography Inter, weight semibold for headlines. Keep logo left, small legal footer. No gradients; use subtle drop shadow if needed.

design-bot: Uploaded starter template: https://figma.redwood/app/file/0/TilePack_v1 (internal) — includes hero 1200x628, square 1080x1080, thumbnail 600x600, deck cover 1920x1080.

raj: Can we get 3 benchmark callouts that are digestible for social: 1) latency emphasis (big ms), 2) cost emphasis (big $/1k tokens), 3) throughput emphasis (req/s). Each should have a short one-line explainer and a subtle sparkline.

lee: prefer icon variations too — clock, dollar, speedometer. Keep icons monochrome to match brand.

emma: also need a templated slide with placeholder screenshot area (16:9), headline, 3 bullets, and a data bar component that can display p50/p95. Add overlay option for light/dark screenshots.

carmen: legal + privacy check: include small CI link and caption: “Results based on Redwood internal benchmarks, Mar 2026. Your results may vary.”

lee: will provide the benchmark CSV and screenshots by EOD today.

emma: design asks summarized:
- deliverables: Figma file + exports: PNG 1200x628 (x2 light/dark), PNG 1080x1080 (3 variants), PNG 600x600 thumbnail, PNG deck cover 1920x1080, SVG icons, and a PSD layered master if possible.
- styles: primary/#0057D9, accent/#00C2A6, text #0A0A0A for light, #FFFFFF for dark, Inter family.
- copy: short taglines per asset (I’ll paste below).
- accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text on hero tiles.

carmen: copy snippets (feel free to shorten):
- Latency: "86ms median latency — faster, predictable inference."
- Cost: "$0.38 per 1k tokens — keep costs down without sacrificing quality."
- Throughput: "220 req/s on Dedicated — consistent scale for production."

emma: quick mockup notes in Figma. @lee when you upload CSV please include p50/p95 and sample input lengths so we can craft sparkline shapes that match.

lee: will do. CSV link: drive.redwood/benchmarks/mar-2026.csv

raj: estimation: design 6–8 hours, QA + exports 2 hours. Can delivery be Mon morning? that gives marketing a day to schedule.

emma: I can review Mon morning. If needed, prioritize the 1200x628 hero + 1080x1080 social tiles first, then deck cover.

carmen: perfect. thanks all — please post when first draft is up. :thumbsup:

design-bot: First draft uploaded to Figma page "Drafts / Webinar Tile Pack" — comments enabled.

lee: uploaded CSV and sample screenshots.

emma: noted a small brand compliance ask from legal — they requested the logo padding be at least 16px on all sides and the legal caption font size no smaller than 10pt. I added it as a Figma comment.

raj: putting a calendar reminder for Mon 09:30 review.

carmen: thanks team, will route to demand gen once approved.

emma: one more — can we get a flat PNG variant optimized for LinkedIn ad creative (1200x627 exact) and a mobile crop (1080x1350) so paid ops can spin up quickly?

raj: noted — will include those exports.

carmen: end of thread — updates in figma comments.
